subject.title: fix(config): improve validation error messages with line numbers, bracket paths, and received values

question: What disclosure contract should `openclaw config validate` use for received values from environment-resolved, included, or plugin-defined configuration?
rationale: The patch can mechanically format a value, but repository policy cannot determine whether raw literals, effective inputs, or plugin-owned values are safe to print without an explicit owner decision.

options.title: Fail closed on uncertain provenance
options.body: Show effective received values only when the validation producer marks them safe, and omit the hint for environment, include, SecretRef, or unclassified plugin values.

options.title: Remove received-value hints
options.body: Land line numbers and bracket paths now, leaving value disclosure for a separately designed validation contract.

options.title: Accept raw-root semantics
options.body: Keep the current raw parsed lookup and explicitly document that `got:` means the root-file literal rather than necessarily the effective rejected value.

recommendation.title: Fail closed on uncertain provenance
recommendation.body: Show effective received values only when the validation producer marks them safe, and omit the hint for environment, include, SecretRef, or unclassified plugin values.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is the strongest available config-cluster reviewer and recent contributor for choosing the validation-output boundary.
